referee_caveats_inferred: Proper-motion uncertainty (one third of the beam) and knot-peak picking at degraded 0.25 arcsec resolution are coarse; peak positions of resolved knots may be biased by missing flux
Excitation temperatures (200 K CO, 300 K SiO/SO) and optically thin assumption drive the column densities and abundances with no stated uncertainty
The BK3 shock model is hand-tuned with no fit or goodness-of-fit, so it is illustrative rather than constraining
Sub-knot period assumes the same jet velocity as the outer knots

missing_for_reproduction: Imaging parameters beyond robust (masks, thresholds, cell and image size, continuum subtraction)

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Two Band 7 12-m executions (2016) plus one 2015 observation with up to ~7.9 km baselines; raw data likely tens to a few hundred GB
reproducibility.score_reason: Project codes and robust values are given, and key results are numeric, but self-calibration, masking, CLEAN settings and the knot-position measurement and model parameters are not specified.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The paper does not state that the data are public, and the recipe for knot peak measurement and the shock model is too loosely specified to redo exactly.
